Network Lead & Security Engineer with proven expertise in designing, implementing, managing, and monitoring LAN/WAN, SD‑WAN, and MPLS infrastructures. LEAD SPECIALIST, NETWORK AND SECURITY, 03/2025 - Current Benchmark Gensuite, BENGALURU Experienced Network Lead and Security Engineer with expertise in designing, implementing, managing, and monitoring global WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, and MPLS environments across geographically distributed enterprise networks. Skilled in configuring and maintaining Juniper SRX firewalls, Aruba switches, Aruba AirWave, ClearPass, IPSec VPNs, and Cloudflare Magic WAN solutions to ensure secure, scalable, and high-performance network infrastructure. Proficient in network monitoring and performance management using tools like CheckMk, with proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues, optimize network reliability, maintain technical documentation, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business-critical operations and global connectivity requirements.

coordination, network monitoring, troubleshooting, and Tier 3/4 support while collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve overall network reliability and scalability.
SENIOR NETWORK SPECIALIST, 06/2024 - 08/2024 HCL TECH, BENGALURU, IN Worked as a Senior Network Specialist supporting Verizon enterprise customers in a 24/7 network environment. Experienced in configuring and troubleshooting BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, and SD-WAN technologies while managing LAN/WAN services, IP addressing, and managed circuit activations. Worked with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Versa, Meraki, and ADTRAN devices, providing network monitoring, packet analysis, troubleshooting, and end-to-end service delivery support.
NETWORK ENGINEER, 05/2019 - 05/2024 Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd., BENGALURU Managed LAN and WAN infrastructure operations, network migrations, and implementation activities for enterprise environments. Supported VoIP and PRI-to-VoIP migrations, SIP troubleshooting, MACD activities, and SBC-related issue resolution while improving network performance through monitoring and troubleshooting. Also handled network documentation and coordinated with vendors and service providers for successful delivery and setup of network services.
